title: FM Synth
description: Rhodes-style electric piano via two-operator FM synthesis with chord progression.

title: Wavetable
description: Smooch wavetable oscillator scanning through a bank of harmonic frames.

title: Microtonal
description: A meditative line in 31-EDO tuning, using micro-step operators to find intervals between the semitones.

title: Polyphony
description: Jazz progression with rich voicings allocated through poly() with a detuned saw pad.

title: Unison Lead
description: Fat detuned 7-voice saw lead via unison() — stereo-spread voices with live detune/width sliders.

title: Unison Pad
description: Polyphonic pad: each chord note fans into a 3-voice detuned unison cluster via poly(@, fat, _, 3).

title: Drums
description: Layered drum kit with nested mini-notation, plus a Euclidean sub-bass tresillo.

title: Effects
description: A pluck running through saturation, lowpass, delay, chorus, reverb, and compressor.

title: Interactive
description: Live UI sliders via param() driving a Moog-filtered saw stack — drag the knobs while it plays.

title: Visualizations
description: Inline oscilloscope, spectrum, and pianoroll views on a single arpeggio.

title: SoundFont
description: Melody layered through two GM piano presets — a dry lead with reverb plus a slowed sub-octave through delay and dattorro.

title: Drum'n'Bass
description: Amen-break chops + jungle bass loaded over HTTPS via samples("github:tidalcycles/Dirt-Samples"). First play fetches; refresh hits the IndexedDB cache.

title: Oscillators
description: The smallest Akkado patch — a sine wave with vibrato. Swap `sine` for `saw`, `tri`, `sqr`, or `noise` to hear each waveform.

title: Chord Stab
description: Strudel-style chord expansion with a filter and envelope.

title: Rock Groove
description: Nested mini-notation drum kit plus a tri-bass riff through a saturated low-pass.

title: MIDI Keys
description: Live MIDI input via `midi() |> poly(@, instrument, voices)` — plug in a USB controller and play.

title: MIDI CC + Bend
description: Mod wheel sweeps cutoff, CC 2 controls resonance, pitch-bend wheel bends ±2 semitones — `midi_cc()` routes external controllers straight into `param()` slots.

title: MIDI Mono Lead
description: Monophonic glide lead with PWM and pitch-bend — `midi_cc()` routes five external controls (cutoff, resonance, PWM, glide time, pitch-bend) into a saw+sub voice.

title: MIDI → SoundFont
description: Live polyphonic SF2 playback from a USB keyboard — `midi() |> soundfont(@, "gm", 0)` runs grand piano notes through the built-in 32-voice SoundFont allocator.

title: Stepper Demo
description: Userspace `step` and `step_dir` operators built from `state`, `counter`, and method-call syntax — no C++ changes.

title: Arpeggiator
description: `e.notes` surfaces each chord as a dynamic array; `step()` walks it on every trigger — a userspace arpeggiator with no new C++ opcode.

title: Harmonizer
description: `map()` over a static interval array turns every melody note into a triad; `saw()` fans out across the array and `sum()` mixes it back.
